edges.reason: msg.sender from the (deployer) constructor is written into the admin state variable.
Constructor parameter _governance is assigned to the governance state variable.
Constructor parameter implementation_ is forwarded to _setImplementation.
_setImplementation writes the implementation state variable, controlling future delegatecalls.
msg.sender is checked against governance inside _setImplementation.
Parameter implementation_ of _setImplementation is stored into implementation.
The current implementation state variable is read into the oldImplementation local.
msg.sender is checked against admin inside _setAdmin.
_setAdmin writes the privileged admin state variable.
Parameter newAdmin is assigned to the admin state variable.
The current admin state variable is read into the oldAdmin local.
msg.sender is checked against governance inside _setGovernance.
_setGovernance writes the privileged governance state variable.
Parameter newGovernance is assigned to the governance state variable.
The current governance state variable is read into the oldGovernance local.
delegateTo executes the arbitrary callee.delegatecall(data) unsafe operation.
Parameter callee becomes the delegatecall target address.
Parameter data becomes the delegatecall payload executed in delegator context.
The delegatecall success flag is stored in the success local variable.
The delegatecall returndata is stored in the returnData local variable.
returnData is consumed by the inline assembly revert in delegateTo.
The assembly revert bubbles the callee failure out of delegateTo.
The fallback forwards all calldata to implementation.delegatecall(msg.data).
The implementation state variable is the target of the fallback delegatecall.
The fallback delegatecall success flag is stored in the success local variable.
The fallback delegatecall returndata is processed by the inline assembly switch.
The assembly return/revert terminates execution of the fallback.
An external delegatecall into the implementation can call back into the delegator's fallback before state settles.
The constructor calls _setImplementation to install the initial implementation.
The constructor calls delegateTo to run the implementation's initialize function.
